testimonials.title: Real User Feedback
testimonials.description: See how agents and agencies use Invictus to close deals faster and work with confidence.

items.name: Emily Watson
items.quote: My shortlists used to live in a notes app and three WhatsApp groups. Now every player, club request, and conversation sits in one place I can actually search.

items.name: James Carter
items.quote: The AI match scores changed how we pitch. We send a sporting director a report that argues the fit with real data instead of a paragraph and a highlight reel.

items.name: Olivia Turner
items.quote: When an agency sends us an Invictus report, we know the profile has been checked against our brief. It saves us a week of back-and-forth on every window.

items.name: Sophia Martinez
items.quote: Integrated statistics on every profile mean I can compare two players in seconds instead of rebuilding a spreadsheet after each match round.

items.name: Liam Anderson
items.quote: Tracking my players — minutes, contract dates, club interest — used to be manual. Invictus keeps the whole roster current without me chasing anyone.

items.name: Marcus Thompson
items.quote: The PDF exports are the part clubs love. Clear, branded, and they answer the exact request we sent — no more digging through email threads.

faq.title: Questions & Answers
faq.description: Clear answers on how Invictus matches talent to clubs, what the AI does, and how agencies get started.

items.question: How does the AI decide a player fits a club?
items.answer: The AI weighs the club brief against integrated performance data on your players, factoring in position, playing style, age, minutes and budget, then explains the reasoning behind each score.

items.question: Can I export an agency report as a PDF?
items.answer: Yes. Every match generates a branded, club-ready PDF setting out why the talent answers that specific request, with the supporting statistics included.

items.question: Does it really replace WhatsApp and email?
items.answer: Conversations with sporting directors, clubs, and players live on the player and club records, so nothing is lost in a group chat or a forwarded thread.

items.question: Where do the player statistics come from?
items.answer: Invictus pulls integrated match and performance data into each profile, and you can add your own scouting notes and video links alongside it.
